title: Logitech G MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard, Low Profile $94 (RRP $229) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Logitech G MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard, Low Profile $94 (RRP $229) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[UncleRico] Bargain. Damaged packaging version is a further $8 off if you’re willing to roll the dice…
[UncleRico] You could see it listed by Amazon Resale under Other Sellers with the description, “Like New - Box Damaged”. Buts it’s sold now.
[Going Broke] I’ve had this for a year now and I do a bit of typing. I’ve recently noticed that the keys are squeaking although all keys work fine. I contacted Logitech support and they are not helpful. So far have exchanged at least 10 emails explaining the issue and sent a video clip (admittedly it’s hard to capture squeaking in video).
They keep closing off my ticket and I have to open a new one.
I bought it from retailer (JB) so I’m now going to take it back there for a replacement. Just FYI.
[montorola] Better than a mechanical?
I have an ajazz ak820 pro and I'm curious about this one
[topherboi] It comes down to personal preference, some like mechanical key, others like low-profile keys.
[thousandsuns] Will be sold out by then 👀
There's only 3 left in stock…
[m3h117108] how about eBay? https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/135374397977?chn=ps&_ul=AU&_trkp…

[captainmac] Because it's good logitech keyboard for an ATL price
[brenwildman] ATL and yet 8% more expensive than ebay for $87 atm
https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/135374397977
[foreverphoenix] You’re comparing apples and oranges. This is not a gaming keyboard. It’s a work keyboard buddy. We do more than just play games on our computers. Some of us actually do work
[brenwildman] I once went for a casual walk in runners and they instantly catch fire. Used to have a recreational sports car until I drove it to work causing it to disintegrate into dust. At least I learnt my lesson unlike that prick who used a high refresh rate gaming monitor to edit a spreadsheet - he deserved to get fired and go blind. All because of a saying that apples and oranges are completely incomparable.
Wait, you didn't use your 'work' keyboard on OzBargain instead of a janky dysfunctional keyboard to write such a comment? RIP having fingers
[hgaoxhgaox] most of time, we have to consider the mechanical keyboard typing sound/noise in office environment, other woould be disturbed by typing in mechanical keyboard.
[thousandsuns] My guy is trolling or doesn't know the difference 😂
[brenwildman] You think there aren't silent mechanical switches? Huh. What next, mechanical means you can't have low profile or short travel?
[slimpickings] Very solid keyboard. I've started rolling it out at work where the expectation is slim apple or apple-style keyboards, but as a traditional keyboard user I never found a slim keyboard I like using. This is the sweet spot. You can usually buy them at about $150, this is a good price.
At RRP it's too expensive, at $150 probably an appropriate price point in the market, at $94 buy it if it fits what you want.
[Raj09] I bought a Dell kb746. Best ever. This is coming from a former logitech keyboard user. Lately logitech has been cutting on costs for its products and it does not feel as good esp the keyboards.
[Rillanon] i love this keyboard but why is the S version never on sale, i don't need the numpad
[topherboi] This keyboard is the 'S' version, the MX Keys Mini version is TKL and is also on sale for $129 .
[EssendonUser] Has anyone here used both the MX Keys S and the Ergo K860?
Which did you end up preferring and why? I'm especially interested in hearing from people who switched from the K860 to the MX Keys S (or vice versa).
[OzBestDeal] I'm currently using K860 as well. I never try MX Key S, but looks like it's serving different purpose.
K860 is a big ergonomic keyboard with huge desk footprint, while MX Key S is a low profile, flat keyboard with smaller desk footprint.
I personally not sure how good the keycaps need to be to justify replacing K860
[freelife] I already have one but had to buy a backup at this price. Steal
[Kanjus] I have this colour. I find the keys difficult to see in some lighting. Should have got the black.
[saiya78] I have one. Bought from last deal in Ozbargain. Its good keyboard.
